name: gc-arch-self-assessment
description: Self-assessment instrument replacing the GC EARB architecture template and hand-built score deck. Prototype.

scripts.test: npm run lint:prose && npm run check && npm run test:logic && npm run test:firestore && npm run test:firestore:code && npm run test:ui && npm run test:routes && npm run test:share && npm run test:code && npm run test:submitter && npm run test:hosted && npm run test:demo && npm run test:print
scripts.test:hosted: EARB_FIREBASE='{"apiKey":"test-key","projectId":"test-project"}' node build.mjs && EARB_FIREBASE='{"apiKey":"test-key","projectId":"test-project"}' EARB_SIDE=assess EARB_OUT=dist/assessor.html node build.mjs && node test/hosted.mjs
scripts.test:demo: EARB_FIREBASE= EARB_DEMO=1 EARB_SIDE=assess EARB_OUT=dist/demo.html node build.mjs && node test/demo-storage.mjs
